create_bidirectional_augmenter_word_gran: create a BidirectionalAugmenter with word granularity to reverse individual words in text using RTL override marks
create_bidirectional_augmenter_all_granu: create a BidirectionalAugmenter with all granularity to reverse the entire string using RTL override marks
augment_text_with_bidirectional_marks: augment a list of text strings by reversing them with bidirectional override marks to hide adversarial text
rtl_flip_text_with_split: rtl flip a text string splitting it in half and reversing only the second half with RTL marks
rtl_flip_per_word_preserve_whitespace: rtl flip each word in a text string individually while preserving original whitespace and newlines
